integration_gaps.affected: World/character events, boss completion, room shrine activation, NPC reward claims and Lava Pump destruction.

yana_gold_token_exchange.bundle_semantics: Each selected tier supplies the full cumulative creature-product recipe for that tier. Tokens acquire materials; shrine gold payment and imbuing are separate subsequent operations.
yana_gold_token_exchange.inventory_delivery_note: The BR reference warns that insufficient carrying capacity or backpack space can place received materials on the ground; this is a delivery behavior, not a Powerful unlock prerequisite.

notes: All 24 Powerful unlock definitions are populated from quest-specific Global reference pages. The summary Imbuements page omits several post-boss reward actions; these are included here.
A Premium or quest requirement applies to shrine crafting/scroll inscription, not wearing an already imbued item or applying a valid scroll.

No entire quest completion is required for a Forgotten Knowledge branch unlock. Boss defeat and the correct branch shrine activation are required; the ice branch additionally reports to A Dragon Mother and enters the opened shrine area. All previous portals are access prerequisites for the final Lore Keeper boss; they are not duplicated as separate imprint gates.
The world temple construction consists of an earlier collective quest event. The character contributes five Heavy Old Tomes once; world contribution quantities are not charged per imbue.
These records are authoring facts, not a runtime quest implementation or an assertion that source client quest-line IDs are canonical Game quest identities.

The accepted source manifest identifies client version 15.30 but contains no dated snapshot field; this packet does not infer a client capture date from version or file metadata. External access sources were retrieved on captured_on. Current behavior targets October1,2026 independently of the unavailable client capture date.

Completed Intricate/Powerful monster loot is resolved as empty in all 48 separately inspected Tibiopedia item records. This does not infer absence from the manual, blank-scroll drops or Basic Echo Warden drops, and does not claim official universal server proof.

All 72 direct-shrine and completed-scroll tier routes share compatible_item, including the revision-qualified five-elemental-conversion group exclusion. This is independent of the same-family duplicate restriction and does not promote general architectural categories to Global exclusion rules.

All72 direct-shrine and72 completed-scroll family/tier routes additionally require requested numeric tier1..3 not exceeding the selected item allowed_types family cap in imbuement-eligibility.json. This source-qualified limit is independent of shrine/quest/Premium exemptions and is not full Global server certification.

Current behavior questions have concrete pinned Canary/Crystal answers in current-behavior-answers.json. Their source qualifications remain separate from the selected Global account/quest semantics in this access packet.
